en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tranquil pond with small rowing boats and a little pavilion on an islet. On the right shore stands a picturesque lakeside building with two domed towers, backed by a large classical-looking structure on a hill. A tall tower rises among trees on the left. The scene is framed by trees and parkland. The printed captions at the top read "Dresden" on the left and "Zwingerteich" on the right.
